product.name: Prospect Site Acquisition
product.description: A platform that consolidates data sources and geospatial tools to identify and evaluate potential sites for infrastructure deployment.

product.name: Catalyst Site Control
product.description: A platform that automates lease workflows and document management to secure site control and prepare for project development.

product.name: Forge Project Management
product.description: An integrated project management platform offering real-time visibility, workflow automation, and GIS-enabled insights for infrastructure projects.

product.name: Command Asset Management
product.description: A centralized platform for managing infrastructure assets, leases, maintenance, and financial performance with real-time insights and operational automation.

product.name: Nexus Leasing Operations
product.description: A platform that streamlines the sales and leasing process by managing deals, automating contract workflows, and facilitating stakeholder communication.
